payload.name: Charat
payload.description: 将聊天内容以视觉小说形式播放
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Charat displays ChatGPT character conversations as a continuing visual novel using saved portraits, expressions, backgrounds, audio, maps and memories. Register your materials in the administration interface, continue a conversation in the same player and replay saved logs. Saved data is isolated by the connected account. Account identification is required to access private data. Charat does not generate images or music, send external messages, sell products or process payments.
payload.longDescription:
Charat通过使用保存的肖像、表情、背景、音频、地图和记忆，将ChatGPT角色对话呈现为持续进行的视觉小说。
您可以在管理界面中注册素材，通过同一播放器继续对话并回放保存的对话记录。
保存的数据会根据关联账户进行隔离。
访问私有数据需要账户验证。
Charat不生成图像或音乐，不发送外部消息，不销售产品也不处理支付。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Character conversation player, Character and scene management, Private memories and conversation logs

payload.name: Keyshift Chord Transposer
payload.description: 转换调式与变调夹形状
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Keyshift Chord Transposer is an entertainment tool for playing chord sheets on guitar or ukulele. Paste chords above your own lyrics or ChordPro inline brackets, then change the key by semitones, a named key pair or a capo fret. Roots and slash bass notes move while quality text stays in place. Chord starts keep their columns unless longer names collide; later chords then move right with a separating space. Tabs use 8-column stops.

The live monospaced sheet has down and up semitone controls. A capo chart shows frets 0 to 9, the shapes to play and counts of easy open chord names. Transposition includes a printable PDF using a monospaced Courier layout; long lines continue at shared column boundaries and chord/lyric pairs stay together.

Limits: 12,000 characters per sheet, semitone input -11 to +11, capo frets 0 to 9, and capo lists of 1 to 100 chords. Chord names only; no audio, tablature or staff notation. The key estimate uses the first and last chord and can be wrong for songs that change key. PDF text is limited to Western Latin characters supported by Courier; other scripts and unsupported characters are refused before a file is produced. Lyrics are kept in widget-only metadata and an encrypted stateless download link, with no server-side lyric storage.
payload.longDescription:
Keyshift Chord Transposer 是一款用于在吉他或尤克里里上演奏和弦谱的娱乐工具。将和弦粘贴在自己歌词上方或 ChordPro 内联括号中，然后通过半音、指定调式或变调夹品数进行调式转换。根音和斜线低音符会移动，而优质文本保持原位。和弦名称保持原有列位置，除非名称过长导致冲突；后续和弦会向右移动并保留间隔空格。琴谱使用8列制表符定位。

实时等宽乐谱包含上下半音控制按钮。变调夹图表显示0-9品的指法形状及简易开放和弦名称数量。转调功能支持使用等宽 Courier 字体布局的打印PDF；长行会在共享列边界处换行，和弦/歌词组合保持完整。

限制条件：每页最多12,000个字符，半音输入范围-11至+11，变调夹品数0-9，变调夹列表最多包含1至100个和弦。仅支持和弦名称；不包含音频、琴谱或五线谱记号。调式估算基于首尾和弦，歌曲中途转调时可能出错。PDF文本仅限Courier字体支持的西方拉丁字符，其他文字系统及不支持字符会在生成文件前被拒绝。歌词仅以组件专用元数据和加密无服务器存储下载链接形式保留。

payload.name: AstroZaza
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AstroZaza combines astrology and tarot with her own knowledge library and accurate astrological calculations. Discover your birth chart, explore relationships and transits, or delve into a tarot reading. She connects patterns into a personal interpretation and makes her sources and calculation data transparent upon request.
payload.longDescription: AstroZaza将占星术与塔罗牌结合她自身的知识库和精确的占星计算。探索您的星盘，分析关系与行星相位，或进行塔罗牌解读。她将星象模式转化为个性化解读，并在需要时公开其数据来源和计算依据。

payload.name: RelayPlay
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find podcasts that fit what you want to hear. Explore recommendations and independent shows, inspect episodes, or bring your podcast list with you by selecting screenshots. Review the matches before importing them.

Save a podcast, subscribe with your chosen listening mode, or add a selected episode to Flow. You stay in control: library changes require an explicit request or confirmation.

Get answers from the RelayPlay handbook. With separate, optional permissions, view your last synced Flow and saved Moments. Choose one Moment to discuss or check its books, music, apps, websites and other findings against public sources. Recognition and research can make mistakes; uncertain matches are identified.

Public search and help work without sharing your library. App actions and shared Flow/Moments require a compatible RelayPlay 1.6 app and connection. These views show the last synced state. Moment audio is not uploaded. Remote playback control and scheduled playback are unavailable.
payload.longDescription:
找到符合您收听需求的播客

保存播客、用您偏好的收听模式订阅，或将选定集数添加至Flow
您始终掌握控制权：库内容变更需要明确请求或确认
